title: Diploma In Health and Social Care (Level 3)
description: Develop comprehensive knowledge and practical skills to uphold ethical practices, ensure effective communication, and prioritize safety and person-centred care in health and social care settings.
longDescription: This course provides a foundational understanding of the essential responsibilities and practices within health and social care environments. It explores the core principles of communication, ethics, personal development, safety, and information handling while emphasizing the importance of person-centred approaches and professional accountability. Learners will acquire the knowledge and skills needed to deliver compassionate, competent, and compliant care. Time Table The programme runs from 26 October 2026 to 26 July 2027, covering six academic learning and assessment periods. Teaching includes guided lectures, practical activities, case studies, group discussions, independent study and assignment preparation. A Winter Vacation is scheduled from 21 December 2026 to 8 January 2027, followed by a Spring Vacation from 29 March to 16 April 2027. The final period focuses on assignment completion, assessment, quality assurance, academic review and confirmation of programme completion, with results processed in August 2027.
courseDetails: This course provides learners with essential knowledge and practical skills required for working in health and social care settings. It covers core areas including effective communication, ethical practice, personal development, information handling, health and safety, person-centred care, and professional responsibilities. Designed for aspiring or current care workers, the course equips individuals to deliver safe, respectful, and responsive care while adhering to legal and ethical standards.

entry: There are no formal entry requirements for this qualification.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

modules.title: Level 3 - Effective Communication And Ethical Practice In Health And Social Care
modules.summary: This module explores the principles of effective communication and ethical practice in care settings, emphasizing the importance of empathy, confidentiality, and cultural sensitivity in fostering trust and respect between care workers and service users.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Foundations of Communication in Health and Social Care
Unit 2 Overcoming Barriers to Communication
Unit 3 Ethical Principles and Professional Conduct
Unit 4 Cultural Competence and Inclusive Communication

modules.title: Level 3 - Effective Handling Of Information In Health And Social Care Settings
modules.summary: This module focuses on the secure and ethical management of personal and sensitive information, emphasizing compliance with data protection regulations and confidentiality standards in care environments.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Understanding Information Handling and Its Importance in Health and Social Care
Unit 2 Legal and Ethical Considerations in Handling Information
Unit 3 Recording, Storing, and Sharing Information in Care Settings
Unit 4 Confidentiality, Security, and Data Protection in Health and Social Care

modules.title: Level 3 - Health, Safety And Well-being In Health And Social Care Settings
modules.summary: This module highlights the importance of maintaining a safe working environment, including the identification and mitigation of risks, emergency procedures, and promoting the well-being of both staff and service users.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Understanding Health, Safety, and Wellbeing in Health and Social Care Settings
Unit 2 Risk Assessment and Management in Health and Social Care
Unit 3 Legislation and Policies for Health and Safety in Care Settings
Unit 4 Promoting Wellbeing and Preventing Harm in Health and Social Care Environments

modules.title: Level 3 - Person-centred Approaches In Health And Social Care Settings
modules.summary: This module emphasizes the delivery of care that respects and values individual preferences, needs, and dignity, ensuring that service users are actively involved in decisions affecting their care.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Person-Centred Care
Unit 2 Building Effective Relationships with Service Users
Unit 3 Empowerment and Advocacy in Health and Social Care
Unit 4 Care Planning and Assessment in Person-Centred Approaches

modules.title: Level 3 - Personal And Professional Development In Health And Social Care
modules.summary: This module supports learners in setting goals for personal and professional growth, encouraging reflective practice, continuous learning, and ethical decision-making to maintain competence in care delivery.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Self-Awareness and Personal Reflection
Unit 2 Setting Personal and Professional Goals
Unit 3 Developing Key Skills for Career Success
Unit 4 Time Management and Productivity Techniques
Unit 5 Networking and Building Professional Relationships

modules.title: Level 3 - Responsibilities Of A Health And Social Care Worker
modules.summary: This module outlines the key duties and responsibilities of care workers, including accountability, legal compliance, working within agreed ways of working, and collaborating effectively with other professionals.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Understanding the Role of a Health and Social Care Worker
Unit 2 Principles of Safeguarding and Protection in Health and Social Care
Unit 3 Effective Communication in Health and Social Care Settings
Unit4 Duty of Care and Professional Boundaries

outcomes: Demonstrate effective verbal, non-verbal, and digital communication techniques appropriate for diverse individuals in health and social care settings.
Apply ethical principles and frameworks to ensure respectful, confidential, and person-centred care that upholds individual rights and dignity.
Evaluate the importance of personal and professional development by setting reflective goals to improve performance in health and social care roles.
Implement secure methods of recording, handling, storing, and sharing information in accordance with data protection laws and organisational policies.
Identify and respond to potential risks and hazards to promote a safe and healthy environment for both care recipients and providers.
Support the physical, emotional, and mental well-being of individuals through health-promoting practices and preventative care measures.
Deliver person-centred care by recognising and respecting individual preferences, needs, and values, thereby encouraging independence and participation in decision-making.
Understand the legal, ethical, and professional responsibilities of a health and social care worker, including duty of care and adherence to standards.
Collaborate effectively with colleagues, service users, families, and external professionals to ensure cohesive, high-quality care.
Reflect critically on personal values, practices, and professional boundaries to enhance accountability and maintain high standards of care.
